dedupe_keys.name: land cover classification map of germany s agricultural area from sentinel 2a 2016 apic method pangaea

description: A map of 19 land cover classes, most of them crop types, across Germany's agricultural area for 2016, produced from Sentinel-2A imagery with APiC, an adaptable pixel-based compositing and classification approach built to cope with frequent cloud cover. The PANGAEA metadata say the classification was run separately in six landscape regions, used ground validation data from the German federal states and more than 10,000 random forest models, and reached 88 percent overall accuracy, about 90 percent for the main classes. The classes forest, other vegetation, water and urban area were taken from official geobasis data, not classified. The dataset was published in 2020 by Preidl, Lange and Doktor as a downloadable ZIP archive of 136.1 MB under CC BY-SA 4.0, as a supplement to a Remote Sensing of Environment article. Coverage is all of Germany for one year. Caveats: a single year, class imbalance lowers accuracy for minor crops, and the share-alike licence applies to derivatives. For simulation it gives crop type by field to estimate the crop exposure to floods, droughts and hail, and the demand for rural water and transport. A related catalogue record is the national-scale crop and land cover map of Germany 2016 from Sentinel-2A and Landsat-8.
